title: The Mark on Jack's Door
synopsis: Jack notices the height marks at home and wonders if becoming five will change him immediately; at Pine Park he discovers he likes both his new Moon drawings and his crooked first truck picture.
continuity_state: Before: The six space travelers safely returned from the Moon. Rex, Gus, Jack and Molly are home; Scout and the solar-powered rover station remain on the Moon; the Pine Park picture board and town infrastructure are intact. Jack is nearly five. After: Jack and his dad measure his height with a new pencil mark on the doorframe. His fifth-birthday picnic is planned for Saturday at Pine Park; Jack remains nearly five. Nothing has changed about the park or Moon station.
